draft_text: Nimbrake seems to offer somewhat higher throughput than Caskline on Driftbay-Serve, although this is only a tentative reading of the 142 versus 119 requests-per-second measurements.
revised_text: Nimbrake seems to offer somewhat higher throughput than Caskline on Driftbay-Serve, although this is only a tentative reading of the 142 versus 119 requests-per-second measurements.
rationale: Numbers match (142 vs 119 rps, higher-is-better). The claim is appropriately tentative ("seems", "tentative reading"), no significance asserted, and the table note confirms non-comparability due to different batch sizes, which the hedged wording respects.
